Risk Descriptions:
This is the possibility that the
group may encounter financial
challanges and as a result not
manage to meet its cash outflow
obligations hence limiting its
inflows.
Mitigation Strategies:
• We are managing corporate debt through the
implementation of our strategy to reduce our
debt level.
• There is regular monitoring of cash flows and
reports are provided to the board, Executive
committee, and management. Reporting
activities include the provision of rolling liquidity
reports, forecasts and cash flow, and treasury
performance reporting of key metrics.
• We have ensured there is an access to lines
of credit through negotiating credit lines with
different banks and other financial institutions.

Risk Descriptions:
This is the risk market shift
dynamics may result to
disruptions on the Group
portfolio and hence inhibit
expected return on investements.
Mitigation Strategies:
• TransCentury maintains a well-balanced and
diversified portfolio in terms of asset classes,
geographical locations.
• We regularly monitor and evaluate our portfolio’s
performance to identify potential risks early and
take corrective and protective action.
• Transcentury has ensured there is a limit to
asset allocation to mitigate concentration risk.
this help to smooth out portfolio volatility and
reduce the risk of significant losses.

Risk Descriptions:
This is the risk that cost of
borrowing and financing the
business will vary over
a period of time within the
financial year, this could be
instigated by CBR and inflation
affecting the overal financial
sector. Such fluctuations may
have a huge impact on the
finance costs of the company.
Mitigation Strategies:
• TransCentury prefers variable / floating interest
rates for short-term financing instruments
(including short term drawings), while selecting
fixed interest rates for long-term financing
instruments.
• Management proactively negotiates interest
rates with banks for potential financing deals

Risk Descriptions:
Transcentury is active on the
international market, which
means that it is exposed to risks
arising from currency (cid:179)uctuations,
particularly in the US dollar, this
risk arises from future commercial
transactions, recognized assets
and liabilities, and net investments
in foreign operations.
Mitigation Strategies:
• The group denominates internal loans in relevant
currencies, to match the currencies of assets
and liabilities in entities with different functional
currencies.
• Using natural hedges this occur when assets
or liabilities in different currencies offset each
other, reducing overall currency risk.
